market_question: Will PSG win the 2025–26 Champions League?
reasoning: PSG’s true chance to win the 2025–26 Champions League is far below the 58.5% implied by the market. Kylian Mbappé departed in 2024, weakening the squad. The club has no Champions League victory and historically underperforms in knockout rounds. Even dominant pre-season favorites rarely exceed 25% win probability in a 32-team tournament, making this price absurdly overvalued.
evidence_points: Kylian Mbappé left PSG for Real Madrid in summer 2024, significantly reducing attacking quality.
PSG has never won the Champions League and has a history of early exits in knockout stages.
Bookmaker odds and betting markets for any team to win the Champions League before a season starts rarely exceed 25% due to knockout randomness and the number of elite competitors.
